_comment: PA1 PII linter hook for Sourcegraph Cody.
Install: copy this file to ~/.config/sourcegraph/cody.json (user-wide) or
.cody.json (per-project) and merge with your existing config.
postMessage: after Cody writes/edits a file, scan it. Exit 2 on HIGH+
to block the response and force Cody to redact.
Cody passes the affected file path via stdin JSON (key: filePath) —
the hook script extracts it with a small python one-liner.

hooks.command: bash -c 'p=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"filePath\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); case "$p" in *.csv|*.jsonl|*.md) pa1-lint scan -- "$p" || exit 2;; esac'
